localChanges: chore: update core-treasury, core-unit and civ1-treasury

log: A `SellImprovement` player action is offered for each city. The `Sell` rule values an improvement at its cost in shields, 1 gold each, as v474.05 does, and gives nothing for a Wonder or for a city that has already sold this turn. The `Sold` rule records the turn. That record isn't saved, so a game loaded mid-turn lets a city sell once more that turn.

`PlayerTreasury.sell(cityImprovement)` destroys the improvement and adds its sale value, then processes the new `Sold` rule. The value comes from the new `Sell` rule (`saleValue()`), as `Spend` gives a purchase price; no `Sell` result in the treasury's yield means it can't be sold. `CityImprovement` gains a `saleValue` AdditionalData so a client can show the price.

`Player.units` listed destroyed units too (`getByPlayer(player, true)`), from when the whole player was sent on every change. A client now gets a destroyed unit once, marked destroyed, and the list should drop it after that. Otherwise the client keeps the unit and the home city it carries, and nothing updates either again (civ-clone/web-renderer#459).
